article_title: Floating nature islands installed in Glasgow parks as Games legacy
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level A; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Floating wildlife islands being added to Glasgow park ponds as an environmental Games legacy
New sports venues being built on islands in the River Clyde
Glasgow replacing five parks with housing
A company exporting drinking-water pipes from Scotland
tasks.correct_answer: Floating wildlife islands being added to Glasgow park ponds as an environmental Games legacy
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת באיים צפים שמותקנים בבריכות פארקים כדי לשפר את הטבע והמים כחלק ממורשת המשחקים.

tasks.prompt: How much new wildlife habitat will the project create?
options: About 20 square metres
Almost 250 square metres
Five square kilometres
Exactly 2,026 square metres
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפרויקט צפוי ליצור כמעט 250 מ״ר של בית גידול חדש.

tasks.prompt: What role do the plants' roots play?
options: They power the islands with electricity
They prevent and remove harmful algae
They increase the speed of the islands
They keep visitors away from the parks
tasks.correct_answer: They prevent and remove harmful algae
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השורשים מסייעים למנוע ולהסיר אצות מזיקות מן המים.

tasks.prompt: What does “buoyancy” mean in the description of the recycled plastic materials?
options: The ability to float on water
The ability to produce flowers
The strength to resist rust
The process of cleaning algae
tasks.correct_answer: The ability to float on water
tasks.explanation_hebrew: buoyancy היא היכולת של חומר או מבנה לצוף על פני המים.

tasks.prompt: Which groups are helping with planting and maintenance?
options: Professional football clubs and airlines
Only Biomatrix engineers
Local schools and friends-of-the-park groups
Tourists from Boston and Venice
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בתי ספר מקומיים וקבוצות ידידי הפארק מסייעים בשתילה ובתחזוקה.

tasks.prompt: Why are the islands placed in the middle of the water?
options: To make them easier for cars to reach
To hide them from community volunteers
To provide birds with nesting space protected from disturbance
To stop aquatic wildlife from using their roots
tasks.correct_answer: To provide birds with nesting space protected from disturbance
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המיקום במרכז המים יוצר לציפורים מקום קינון שמוגן יחסית מהפרעות.

tasks.prompt: What materials and layers are used to build the floating islands?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין פלסטיק ממוחזר, פלדת אל־חלד ימית, שכבת leca קלה והצמחים המוחדרים לתוכה.
expected_points: Recycled plastic, including drinking-water pipes, provides buoyancy.
Marine-grade stainless steel holds the structure together.
A lightweight clay aggregate called leca covers the top.
Aquatic plants are inserted into the leca.

tasks.prompt: In 2–3 sentences, describe two ways the islands support wildlife.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהשורשים מספקים מחסה לבעלי חיים במים ושהמיקום יוצר מרחבי קינון לציפורים ללא הפרעה.
expected_points: Plant roots beneath the islands shelter aquatic wildlife.
The position in open water gives birds relatively undisturbed nesting spaces.

tasks.prompt: Write 3–4 sentences explaining how the project connects the Commonwealth Games with local communities.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין מימון Glasgow 2026, יעד המשחקים הירוקים, השתתפות בתי ספר וקבוצות קהילה, וגאווה בפארקים ובטבע העירוני.
expected_points: Glasgow 2026 funds the project as part of its greener-Games commitment.
Community groups are planting the islands.
Local schools and friends-of-the-park groups will help maintain them.
The project celebrates local pride in parks, green spaces and the natural environment.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the floating-island project in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את חמשת הפארקים, מטרות הניקוי ובית הגידול, החומרים, מיני הצמחים, והמורשת הסביבתית של המשחקים.
expected_points: The islands are being installed on ponds in five Glasgow parks.
They will create almost 250 square metres of habitat and help clean the water.
They use recycled plastic, marine-grade steel and leca.
Native plants provide shelter for aquatic wildlife and nesting space for birds.
The project is funded as a greener legacy of the 2026 Commonwealth Games.
